revenueModel.text: Brands, sponsors, tournament organizers and online platforms pay for esports teams, talent management, event production and Bitcoin mining.
revenueModel.evidence: The esports industry is characterized by its ever-changing and fast evolving nature, where every year different digital games are released by game developers, and various leagues and tournaments are assembled, creating vast opportunity for participants like us to extend our brand influence and generate popularity, and for brands and sponsors to invest in teams, athletes, and benefit from screen time and name placements.
